slides.title: You hang on between reps.
slides.body: Resting while hanging off the bar keeps your forearms working. That's grip work nobody programmed.

slides.title: Plan the break before it fails.
slides.body: Toes-to-bar, deadlifts, carries. Two short planned breaks beat one long forced one.

slides.title: Hands low, fingers loose.
slides.body: Arms down by your sides and shake. Squeezing your water bottle between sets is still gripping.

slides.title: Hook grip on cleans and snatches.
slides.body: Thumb under your fingers. The bar stops prying your hand open. Odd for two weeks, then it sticks.

slides.title: Grip as hard as the rep needs.
slides.body: A kettlebell swing needs a firm hold, not white knuckles. Save the full squeeze for heavy pulls.
